facts.title: ginger fried rice
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced leeks, white and light green parts only, rinsed and dried
4 cups day-old cooked rice; Vongerichten recommends jasmine but this is the perfect way to use up any leftover rice you have, especially from Chinese delivery
2 teaspoons sesame oil (for some heat but the same awesome flavor, use hot sesame oil)
facts.author: Deb Perelman
